title: The Twelvefold Binding and Release of the Soul in the Body
description: A clean mechanical sequence: Sin builds the body from the Five Worlds of Darkness, binds the soul's five faculties (mind/thought/teaching/counsel/reflection) into five somatic substrates (bone/sinew/vein/flesh/skin), and overlays Sin's counter-faculties as exousiastai. The Mind of Light then performs an exact inverse exchange — raising each soul-faculty out and binding Sin's correlate in its place — constituting the freed members as the New Man with five heavenly virtues: love, faith, perfection, patience, wisdom.
